responses_api.contract: New application integrations may use Responses API where the application host implements it; a Skill file alone does not provide this runtime.

agents_sdk.contract: Use only in an application that integrates Agents SDK; a Markdown Skill alone does not provide agent lifecycle or tracing.

mcp.contract: MCP requires an MCP-capable host and configured server; Skill content alone does not create a connection.

structured_output.contract: Prefer schema-validated output for ledgers, routing records, and handoffs.

requested_actual_separation.contract: requested_model and actual_model are independent fields; use UNVERIFIED when runtime telemetry is absent.

responses_api.support: integration guidance only; a Markdown Skill does not expose this runtime

agents_sdk.support: integration guidance only; requires an application host implementing the SDK

mcp.support: integration guidance only; requires a host configured with an MCP client/server
